title: Context pack (resolver output)
description: The bounded execution context the ELMM resolver emits for one task. Each member projection is a projection per CORE-009 (virtual projections per CORE-012) and references exactly one Meta-Object, satisfying OBJ-R29; the pack as a whole is a Composite Projection, filed upstream as a change request rather than forked locally. The pack obeys seven context rules: single anchor, minimal-sufficient content, projections not objects, provenance plus version pins (every member carries provenance, the pack carries version pins), least privilege, no secrets, just-in-time dereference (identifiers plus short summaries, detail pulled on demand). Version pins carry the Semantic Fingerprint per ARCH-009, never a byte hash. Exactly one economic parameter exists, max_tokens: when the assembled members exceed the budget, the resolver degrades members to summary form and records the degradation in the coverage statement. The pack carries requester_identity and purpose; the projection builder is the enforcement point for any future entitlement mapping, with deny by default when a declared mapping cannot be evaluated. observed_at is supplied by the resolver from its input, never from a wall clock, so a resolution is bit-reproducible. Inlined for offline validation: model ids use the inlined registry id pattern rather than a remote reference.

task_ref.description: Reference to the task descriptor this pack was resolved for. Taken from the descriptor's task_ref, or minted by the resolver when the descriptor omits it.

model_id.description: Registry id of the model this member projects from. Inlined id shape.

anchor.description: Namespace-qualified CSN of the single Meta-Object this member projects. Exactly one anchor per member (OBJ-R29, CORE-009).

form.description: full: the projected content in minimal-sufficient depth. summary: identifiers plus short summaries under the just-in-time dereference rule; the consumer asks for more.

content.description: The projected content in the declared form. Projections, not objects: the member never embeds the source model wholesale.

provenance.description: Source and derivation of this member: the model version and Semantic Fingerprint it was projected from and the fetch point. Every member carries provenance (context rule four); the pack additionally carries pack-level provenance and version pins.

tokens.description: Estimated token cost of this member, counted against max_tokens.

member_projections.description: Ordered member projections. The order is the assembly order of the Composite Projection.

coverage_statement.description: What the pack covers, what was delivered in summary form, and any budget degradation that occurred. The consumer's contract for what it may assume is present.

id.description: Registry id of the resolved model. Inlined id shape.

semantic_fingerprint.description: Semantic Fingerprint per ARCH-009. The semantic pin; never a byte hash.

version_pins.description: One pin per resolved model, the result of Minimal Version Selection over declared minimums.

registry_ref.description: The registry repository state this resolution read, for example a git commit. Git commit identifiers suffice as provenance in v0.1.

routing_log.description: Every resolution decision, logged: hint matches, edge walk, version selection.

provenance.description: How this pack came to be. Provenance plus version pins is a normative context rule; every member additionally carries its own provenance.

observed_at.description: When the resolver last observed the sources, supplied from resolver input, never a wall clock. Compared against each model's declared sync_contract freshness; a stale pack is emitted with a staleness flag in the coverage statement and the consumer decides, per ARCH-018 freshness.

max_tokens.description: The token budget for the whole pack. The single economic parameter in v0.1.

exclusions.description: What was deliberately left out and why: least privilege and minimal-sufficient made auditable.

requester_identity.description: The identity the pack was resolved for. The identity-bound policy attaches here; enforcement happens in the projection builder, not in the consumer.

purpose.description: Declared purpose of the task. Carried for purpose limitation and audit.
